text: 经国务院批复，由北京市人民政府与中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局、中国证券监督管理委员会、新华通讯社、国家外汇管理局共同主办的2026金融街论坛年会定于10月19日至22日在北京金融街举办。本届论坛年会将以“开放·合作·包容——共筑全球金融发展新生态”为主题，邀请国内外经济金融领域重要嘉宾研讨交流，深化国际金融务实合作，凝聚全球金融发展共识，为推动构建开放共赢的全球金融体系注入持久金融力量。据悉，论坛将邀请来自全球40多个国家和地区的演讲嘉宾400人左右，包括国际经济金融组织、多国政府部门、知名中外金融机构、央国企、跨国企业、民营企业代表出席。（新华社
text_en: Approved by the State Council, the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting, co-hosted by the Beijing Municipal People's Government together with the People's Bank of China, the National Financial Regulatory Administration, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, Xinhua News Agency, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, is scheduled to be held in Beijing Financial Street from October 19 to 22. This year's annual meeting will take "Openness, Cooperation, Inclusiveness—Building a New Ecosystem for Global Financial Development Together" as its theme, inviting important guests from domestic and international economic and financial fields to discuss and exchange views, deepen practical international financial cooperation, build consensus on global financial development, and inject lasting financial strength into promoting the construction of an open and win-win global financial system. It is reported that the forum will invite about 400 speakers from more than 40 countries and regions around the world, including representatives from international economic and financial organizations, government departments of multiple countries, well-known Chinese and foreign financial institutions, central state-owned enterprises, multinational enterprises, and private enterprises. (Xinhua News Agency
